hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' 2>/dev/null); echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '^knowledge/.*\.(artifact|verdict)\.md$' && { echo "=== PostToolUse hook: Validating knowledge artifact ===" && python3 scripts/general/check_knowledge_artifacts.py "$FILE" && python3 scripts/general/check_artifact_toc.py "$FILE"; } || true
